args: sh -n tests/toolchain/run-proof-matrix.sh && sh -n tests/toolchain/run-mutants.sh && node --check tests/toolchain/proof.mjs

for m in fixtures/toolchain/mutants/*/; do test -f "$m/MUTANT.json" || { echo "$m has no MUTANT.json"; exit 1; }; node -e 'const j=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(!j.weak||!j.qualified||j.weak.expect!=="PASS"||j.qualified.expect!=="FAIL")process.exit(1)' "$m/MUTANT.json" || { echo "$m: weak must expect PASS and qualified must expect FAIL"; exit 1; }; done; for e in fixtures/toolchain/expect/*.json; do node -e 'const j=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1]));if(!Array.isArray(j.expected_errors)||!j.expected_errors.length||!j.invariant)process.exit(1)' "$e" || { echo "$e: no expected_errors/invariant"; exit 1; }; done; ls fixtures/toolchain/mutants | wc -l

[ "$(awk 'FNR==1{sec=""} /^\[/{sec=$0} { if (sec ~ /dependencies/) { if ($0 ~ /(version|git|registry) *=/ || $0 ~ /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ *= *"/) print FILENAME } }' $(find fixtures/toolchain/mutants -name Cargo.toml | sort) | sort -u)" = "fixtures/toolchain/mutants/M5-uninspected-manifest/gamma/Cargo.toml" ]

fixtures/ stays excluded from the product workspace
